title: Sort Array by Frequency
statement:
Given an array of integers, sort the elements by their frequency in descending order.

If two elements have the same frequency, sort them by value in ascending order.

Print the rearranged array.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers sorted by frequency descending, then value ascending.

examples.explanation: 4 and 5 both appear twice (tie: sorted by value 4<5), 3 and 6 appear once (tie: 3<6).

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
